programme.title: Civic Tech and the Sad Story of Freedom of Information in Hungary
programme.desc: «Átlátszó,» the word means «transparent» in Hungarian, and it is the name of Hungary's first independent investigative journalism website. A watchdog non-government organisation (NGO) which has experimented with introducing Civic Tech solutions in order to facilitate the work of its team, and also to provide citizens with empowering tools. Since Atlatszo.hu was launched in 2011, the Freedom of Information Act has received a lot of attention, and the legal way for questioning public bodies about spending, a «Freedom of Information request» has become the tool for many to reveal information about corruption.Marietta Le will showcase the use of the free software system Alaveteli, and the use of the Freedom of Information Act in Hungary. The law has been changed since 2011, and the latest news is about a threat that would make access to information much harder for Hungarian citizens. Meanwhile, Atlatszo.hu and many others are trying to implement new Civic Tech solutions in Hungary to help people exercise their democratic rights.Marietta Le is an FOI advocate at Atlatszo.hu Hungarian investigative journalism website. She also works with the K-Monitor anti-corruption NGO as a project coordinator to «Be Smart with Data», a program that facilitates NGOs in producing web apps and visualisations using open data. In 2015 the Hungarian Forbes magazine has featured her on their «30 under 30» list for starting «Jarokelo.hu», a street fixing website in Hungary.

programme.title: Frikanalen, ytringsfrihet i TV
programme.desc: Frikanalen er en åpen TV-kanal der alle i dag sikres tilgang til eteren gjennom Riks TV sine sendinger. Fra 2010 vil vi også nå ut på kabel (Get og Canal Digital) via satellitt. Frikanalen er organisert som en forening der NUUG er medlem. Vi i frikanalen tror dette sammen med NUUG sin nett-satsning vil være avgjørende for å trekke yngre og mer kreative frivillige miljøer til kanalen. I dag er det i hovedsak de som hadde innhold, men ingen riksdekkende kanal å sende på, som bruker kanalen, altså de religiøse. Frikanalen er som en "youtube på TV". En 100% nettstyrt TV kanal der produsentene selv tar redaktøransvar, laster opp og legger video på sendeplanen. Vi håper at dette verktøyet med et utvidet nedslagsfelt vil medføre at flere blir produsenter og at mangfoldet med det øker. For å lykkes må verktøyet bli 100% tilgjengelig. Da kan vi ikke nøye oss med silverlight-løsningen vi har i dag, men satse videre på åpne standarder sammen med NUUG.

programme.desc: Oljefondets rolle i Israels folkemord«Den norske staten risikerer å bli dømt for medvirkning til folkemord og krigsforbrytelser i internasjonale domstoler», skriver Øyvind Andresen i siste utgave av avisa Ny Tid. programme.title: TED
programme.sub-title: Linus Torvalds: The mind behind Linux
programme.desc: Linus Torvalds transformed technology twice — first with the Linux kernel, which helps power the Internet, and again with Git, the source code management system used by developers worldwide. In a rare interview with TED Curator Chris Anderson, Torvalds discusses with remarkable openness the personality traits that prompted his unique philosophy of work, engineering and life. "I am not a visionary, I'm an engineer," Torvalds says. programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.desc: En av landets mest anerkjent landskapsarkitekter snakker byrom. Vi skal også snakke om uteromstrender og norsk dun!

programme.title: Flipp med Emilie
programme.desc: Emilie og Håvard finner det perfekte flippeobjektet, og det er duket for en intens budrunde. Kommer de til å klare å holde hodet kaldt, med så mye annet som skjer rundt seg?

programme.title: Nabolaget
programme.desc: I denne episoden møter vi Line Oma, som er representant i Oslo bystyre for AP. På Ensjø bor hun sammen med familien sin i en nybygget firemannsbolig.

programme.title: Boligrådet
programme.desc: Riksantikvaren vil puste liv i bygg – og boliger som står tomme og forfaller landet rundt. FutureBuilt forteller om plastkalkulaturen og hva den skal brukes til.

programme.title: Herlige hjem
programme.desc: På Sandhornøya har hippiefamilien Hjertefølger på fem bygget et leirhus under en stor glassdome som fungerer som et drivhus. Marianne Vigtel Hølland har en tilnærming til design som fremmer refleksjon og en bevisst holdning til hvordan de valgene man tar får konsekvenser for en selv og andre.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here

Det var en tid da hun bare følte kjærlighet til Tony, men ettersom de syke forbrytelsene hans avsløres, er hun takknemlig for at hun lever for å snakke om det.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: Jeanne Avsenew og hennes unge sønn Peter hadde et nært forhold, men etter hvert vokste Peters besettelse for døden. Den dagen Jeanne finner en kule med navnet sitt på, innser hun at sønnen vil ha henne død, og Jeanne må ta drastiske tiltak for å holde seg trygg.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders
programme.desc: To tenåringsjenter oppdager at de går ut med samme gutt, og går til krig mot hverandre på sosiale medier og i det virkelige liv. Det hele får et tragisk utfall.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders
programme.desc: Skyting i en luksusbygning sender sjokkbølger gjennom et elegant nabolag. Politiet finner mange mistenkte og en plan som ble lagt på grunn av sjalusi over penger.

programme.title: The Tech Bro Murders

programme.title: The Tech Bro Murders
programme.desc: Det mystiske drapet på millionæren David Coffin hjemsøker en programvarekonsulent når han tar fatt på valgkampen for å bli guvernør.

programme.title: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace
programme.desc: Natalia flytter inn hos DePaul-paret, men Cynthia og Antwon strammer grepet på avstand. Natalias nærvær skaper splid mellom Nicole og Vince.

programme.title: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace
programme.desc: Natalia kjemper for å unnslippe sine manipulerende foreldre. Når sviket deres blir avslørt, tar hun tilbake livet sitt sammen med en ny familie.

programme.title: The Interrogator
programme.desc: En mors verste mareritt blir virkelighet når den tolv år gamle sønnen hennes bortføres på julaften. Etterforsker Waters gjør alt han kan for å løse saken.

programme.title: The Interrogator
programme.desc: To drosjesjåfører blir drept på en uke, noe som fører til oppstandelse i Houston. Et av drapene er fanget på film, og det virker som to gjerningspersoner står bak.

programme.title: I Almost Got Away With It
programme.desc: Disse forbryterne har ulike bakgrunner, men det som driver dem er alltid det samme: å holde seg utenfor murene og leve et liv på rømmen.

programme.title: Makak-øya

programme.title: Australske slangetemmere: Livsfarlig forfølgelse
programme.desc: Bli med i en kamp om viljestyrke med Adele og Mick når de prøver å lure en pyton ut av et avløpsrør. Følg med mens Jess og Dan prøver å få tak i en kjølrygg-slange før den slipper en stinkbombe, og møt en farlig slange i en universitetsvegg med Stu.

programme.title: Australske slangetemmere: Livsfarlig forfølgelse
programme.desc: Slapp av mens Mick og Adele avbryter to parrende brunsnoker på et sykehjem. Pass på uønskede varer med Stu og Liv, som fanger en grønn treslange på et lager. Snik deg innpå en dødelig gjest med Jess og Dan.

programme.title: Etter skogbrannene

programme.title: Oterne i Singapore
programme.desc: Svøm oppover elven med Bay-familien, der Anna gir en hjelpende hånd i oppfostringen av barnebarna sine før hun drar hjem og oppdager inntrengere på området sitt. En flom i mangrovene holder på å ta med seg en unge, og Townies spiser opp alle matkildene sine.

programme.title: Gladiatorer

programme.title: Kampen om herredømme
programme.desc: Finn ut hvorfor størrelsen teller for disse alfadyrene. Bli tilskuer til en brytekamp mellom gorillaer, vær forsiktig med pågående elggevirer og lange pelikannebb som biter etter alle fiender i nærheten, og la deg forbløffe av stereonesen til en megahai.

programme.title: Vill vitenskap
programme.desc: Få et blikk på innsiden av livet til en av Afrikas mest ikoniske, men misforståtte megafaunaer: flodhesten. Opplev en slåsskamp på nært hold og se hvor livsfarlig bittet til en territoriell hann kan være, og se mirakelet med undervannsfødsler.

programme.title: Makroverdener
programme.desc: Så snart dagene blir kalde og mørke, begynner insektene å forsvinne fra eng og mark. Summingen deres blir svakere før den stilner helt. Alle dyr har sin egen måte å overleve vinteren på. Trekkfugler som svaler og traner flyr sørover, og mange pattedyr som f.eks. rådyr får tykk vinterpels eller går i hi og sover der det er varmt. Men hva gjør insektene, og hvorfor kommer de tilbake om våren?

programme.title: Makroverdener
programme.desc: Skrekk og gru! Det er drap! Brutale dødsfall og nervepirrende kamper med utrolige redninger i siste øyeblikk. Når du har sett dette, skjønner du at det nifseste stedet faktisk er engen i ditt eget nabolag. Denne fantastiske naturdokumentaren benytter seg av elementer fra skrekkfilmsjangeren, og tar deg med på reisen til en kjent helt med seks bein, røde vinger og syv svarte prikker gjennom en tilsynelatende normal eng – som viser seg å være full av monstre.

programme.title: Gjengene på Lemurøya
programme.desc: Tørketiden nærmer seg, og det blir anspent på Lemurøya, både mellom rivaliserende gjenger og innad i flokken. Få et overblikk over slagmarken når lederhunnene forsvarer området sitt med nebb og klør, mens de nyfødte babyene klamrer seg til dem for å være beskyttet.

programme.desc: Bli med forskere når de studerer dyrs kommunikasjon. Finn ut hvordan ulver bruker kroppsspråk for å forene flokken og opprettholde et sofistikert sosialt hierarki, og se det overraskende antallet håndbevegelser sjimpansene bruker for å kommunisere.

programme.title: Det utemmede Zambia

programme.title: Det utemmede Zambia
programme.desc: Mvula er den yngste kalven i Madzi-familien. Temperaturen stiger. Laguner og vannhull tørker ut. Dette tvinger Mvula og familien hans til å dra ut på en lang og farlig reise til den eneste gjenværende vannkilden: Luangwadalen.

programme.title: Gjengene på Lemurøya
programme.desc: Ettersom mat og vann blir en knapphet, setter Crystal, den voldsomme lederen av Ruins-gjengen, blikket mot rivaliserende Katis territorium og dens nabofrukttrær. Se hvordan Crystals trekk og et raid fra inntrengere utenfor fører til alvorlige konsekvenser for én tropp.

programme.title: Camp for bjørnunger
programme.desc: Ønsk søstrene Xiba, Xyla og Xola velkommen, tre sultne unger som snur Winstons verden opp-ned, før den milde Xola viser ham hva vennskap er. Følg med på de nye ungene Yasmine og Yara, som gjenforenes etter en stressfylt separasjon.

programme.title: Makroverdener
programme.desc: Så snart dagene blir kalde og mørke, begynner insektene å forsvinne fra eng og mark. Summingen deres blir svakere før den stilner helt. Men hva gjør insektene, og hvorfor kommer de tilbake om våren?

programme.title: Claudio Abbado & Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra - Mozart - Symphony No. 35, K. 385
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Mozart’s “Haffner” Symphony No. 35, K. 385, recorded during the very first Europakonzert in the Smetana Hall in Prague, 1991. Mozart originally composed the symphony as a serenade for the family of Sigmund Haffner, a childhood friend from Salzburg in 1782. The composer made some revisions in the following year, adding multiple instruments and conducted the premiere of the four-movement piece on March 23, 1783, in Vienna. The “Haffner” Symphony, as it is known now, is a transitional work in Mozart’s career. The work was meant to be party music for Salzburg and was transformed into a symphony for Vienna.

programme.title: The Challenge: All Stars
programme.desc: Anklagelserna haglar när flera par försöker ta reda på vem som styr spelet i kulisserna. Shane tar sikte på en allierad som han känner hotar hans plats och vänskap med Veronica.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Strictly Come Dancing’s Zoe Ball and Ian Waite are quickstepping their way across the south West of England in a bid to turn a profit at auction in Hampshire. Experts Margie Cooper and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to guide. Paul shares a secret with Zoe about buying antique hair brushes. Ian, though, offers dancing lessons to dealers to secure a discount. Lordy! Zoe also hears how one village became world famous for lace production while Ian ends up meeting a giant horse with its own boat.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In this episode, the two candidates of the day, Thibaud Poirier and Antoine Guillou, will have one hour to realize their photo session. They will have to take the best possible photos on the imposed theme of architecture in the 12th district of Paris, and then they will have 30 minutes to edit their photos.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Joaquin Boz habite et travaille à Buenos Aires. C’est ici, dans la capitale de l’Argentine, qu’il pratique son art à mi-chemin entre abstraction et performance corporelle. Sa peinture est recouverte de couches toujours plus nombreuses. Ces tâches, ces mouvements, ces traits et ces raclures, sont le fruit de la transmission des formes et des couleurs depuis son corps vers la toile dans une performance physique de l’artiste qui puise son inspiration dans le courant expressionniste.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a British painter, William Turner.You will discover his labour with London from greenwich park, child hairdo’s pilgrimage, Snow storm.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Eugene Delacroix.You will discover his labour with The barque of Dante, Portrait of Aspasie, The assassination of the bishop of liege.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Après deux ans d’exposition itinérante, en 2015 "La Jeune Fille à la perle” est retournée au musée Mauritshuis de La Haye. Du haut de ses 350 ans, l’éternelle Jeune Fille a toujours su conserver son aura de mystère et son charme. La preuve, c’est le nombre de curieux (1,2 millions) qui ont accouru pour l’apercevoir lors de son séjour au Japon. Le documentaire cherche à découvrir les nombreuses énigmes de cet extraordinaire tableau et de son créateur mystérieux - Vermeer. Qui était cette fille ? Pourquoi et comment Vermeer a-t-il peint ce tableau ? Venez voyager dans le temps pour découvrir Johannes Vermeer, visiter le charmant musée de La Haye et répondre à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Peintre originaire de Florence en Italie, Sandro Botticelli est considéré comme l’un des peintres Italiens les plus connus du 15ème siècle. Proche de la famille Medici, il est admiré et renommé pour ses portraits et ses peintures de femmes nues tout droit inspirées de la mythologie grecques comme le majestic tableau « La naissance de Vénus », exhibé dans la Gallery Uffizi à Florence, et également présent dans cet épisode.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Posée sur les berges du lac Léman, une vague de béton et de verre inspire, depuis sa construction de nombreuses métaphores : certains y voient une tranche d’emmental, un tissu moléculaire, d’autres encore un tapis volant mité. Le bâtiment abrite un «Learning Center», concept nouveau qui désigne un espace multifonctionnel dédié à la connaissance.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Painting the Modern Garden - Monet to Matisse
programme.desc: Passionné d’horticulture, Monet reste sans conteste le maître de la peinture de jardins dans l’histoire de l’art, mais il n’était pas seul. Des artistes tels que Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso et Matisse ont utilisé le jardin comme thème fort de leur œuvre. Ces grands artistes, ainsi que bien d’autres noms célèbres, sont rassemblés dans une exposition innovante du Cleveland Museum of Art et de la Royal Gallery of Arts de Londres. De l’exposition elle-même à la beauté des jardins d’artistes comme celui de Monet à Giverny, nous partons en voyage pour découvrir comment le jardin moderne était utilisé pour explorer de nouvelles idées radicales et merveilleuses.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and music - the art of love and leisure
programme.desc: La National Gallery de Londres propose un nouveau regard sur l'un des plus grands artistes de tous les temps, Johannes Vermeer. Il est le peintre de la célèbre toile “La Jeune Fille à la perle”. Dans une exposition intitulée "Vermeer et la musique : L'art de l'amour et des loisirs

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Lucas Cranach l’Ancien (v. 1472-1553) est un artiste majeur de la Renaissance germanique, actif à Wittenberg dans la première moitié du XVIe s. Peintre officiel de Frédéric le Sage, prince électeur de Saxe, il est proche du réformateur Martin Luther. Au-delà des thèmes bibliques, il s’intéresse particulièrement à la représentation du nu féminin, comme dans l’Adam et Eve de Besançon ou les fameuses Trois Grâces, récemment acquises par le musée du Louvre grâce à un appel aux dons.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Peintre originaire de Florence en Italie, Sandro Botticelli est considéré comme l’un des peintres Italiens les plus connus du 15ème siècle. Proche de la famille Medici, il est admiré et renommé pour ses portraits et ses peintures de femmes nues tout droit inspirées de la mythologie grecques comme le majestic tableau « La naissance de Vénus », exhibé dans la Gallery Uffizi à Florence, et également présent dans cet épisode.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted in 1911, Pablo Picasso’s "La Coiffeuse" is an iconic work of Cubism. The painting was last seen in 1998, following a loan for an exhibition in Munich. On its return to Paris, it was stored in the Centre Pompidou’s storerooms… until the day it was discovered to be missing, in 2001. Had it been stolen from the storerooms? Sixteen years after the theft, in 2014, a ship docked at the port of Newark, in New Jersey, USA. The artwork was on board….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The Boy with a Soap Bubble, Rembrandt
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Deux légendes de la comédie britannique, Ronni Ancona et Jan Ravens, sont accompagnées des antiquaires Phil Serrell et James Braxton pour ce Road Trip. Partant de la ville de Redcar, dans le North Yorkshire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stockport, dans le Cheshire.Jan se laisse emporter et dépense tout son budget, tandis que Ronni se régale d'une paire de bottes en verre très kitsch.Lors d'un détour, Jan découvre pourquoi les habitants de Hartlepool pensaient qu'un singe était un Français, et Ronni reste bouche bée lorsque Braxton enlève ses vêtements. Sacré moment !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: Since the beginning of its history, the Petit Palais has been imagined to highlight masterpieces of art. It is a true setting that magnifies creation in all its forms. Its extraordinary collection allows it to offer visitors a journey through the ages, confronting the great artists and the creative genius of all time, and thus breaking down the ages barrier.

programme.title: Museum Tour
programme.sub-title: La Guerre et la Paix - Dans l’œil de Pablo Picasso
programme.desc: Museum Tour is a series that invites the viewer to discover unique which, for the artists chosen, have been incubators of creativity and a source of inspiration. Under their patronage, some of those sites have been turned into museums or foundations where their memory and work have picked up a life of their own.Each of the episodes will tell the story uniting the artist with a particular place, seeking intimacy in the process.This show’s agenda is decidedly visual. Works of art and the places in which they’re set will be filmed in such a way as to arouse strong emotions, thus placing the viewer in the spot, as if they were present in the flesh. This angle for the spectacular and search for beauty will enhance the accessibility of the series for an uninformed audience.A family-friendly documentary series which, beyond the fascinating information provided, offers a sight, sound and emotional journey into a captivating, palpable and contemporary form.

programme.title: Manet - Degas, a troubled friendship
programme.desc: In 1917 the art world is ablaze: the famous painter and sculptor Edgar Degas has just died, leaving behind him a collection rich of dozens of works from Edouard Manet.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: 200 years after it opened and a century after acquiring its first Van Gogh works, the National Gallery hosted the largest Van Gogh exhibition ever held in the UK (September 14, 2024 to January 19, 2025). The exhibition was a huge success, unanimously praised by the press, and tickets sold out quickly, making this film the only way to see what Forbes called a “once-in-a-lifetime exhibition.”Discover the passion that drove one of the world's most beloved artists to revolutionize art. Van Gogh: Poets & Lovers rewrites history and celebrates Van Gogh's genius without exploiting his suffering, allowing audiences to truly understand this iconic artist in a whole new way...

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vincent Van Gogh : une nouvelle façon de voir
programme.desc: La vie de Vincent van Gogh reste entourée de mystère : folie, maladie, suicide, les ingrédients pour créer un mythe sont tous réunis. Bénéficiant d’un accès complet et sans précédent aux trésors du Van Gogh Museum d’Amsterdam, ce documentaire met en lumière à la fois l’un des artistes préférés du monde et la collection riche et unique du musée. Découvrez ces merveilleux chefs-d’œuvre sur grand écran pendant que quelques invités y compris les conservateurs de renommée mondiale et des historiens de l’art offrent leurs interprétations et des explications sur le travail de Van Gogh.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Situé en plein cœur de Paris, le musée du Louvre abrite une des collections d'art les plus impressionnantes à travers le monde, allant de l’Antiquité jusqu’à l’art moderne. Avec plus de 8 millions de visiteurs par an, le Louvre est le musée le plus visité du monde. A partir de cette collection, nous vous proposons de découvrir des œuvres d’art à ne pas manquer, comprenant « Mona Lisa » de Leonard De Vinci, « Les Noces de Cana » de Veronese, « La liberté guidant le peuple » de Delacroix et « La Grande Odalisque » de Ingres.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: The Museum of Fine Art in the city of Montpellier, in the South of France, bears the name of Francois-Xavier Fabre (1766-1837), who left his personal collection to his native town. Here you can admire the picture “Vertumnus and Permona” by Jean Ranc or “The Women of Algiers” by Delacroix. The collection includes works by the Montpellier painter Jean-Fréderic Bazille, such as his “View of a Village”, and above all paintings by Gustave Courbet, including the famous “Bonjour Monsieur Courbet”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Paris Fine Arts School is one of the oldest and most prestigious art schools. Félix Duban (1797-1870) became its architect in the wake of the 1830 revolution. He would transform this high place of creativity into a veritable palette of architectures. From the Porticus of Octavia in Rome to the Florentine palaces, from the loggias of the Vatican to the polychrome frescoes of Pompeii, everything here is a citation, a souvenir - of Duban's study trip to Italy, for example - but also an ode to the past that remains exemplary for the students. Everything is created to educate the eye of these future artists. Duban thus organizes the general composition of the space around authentic fragments of monuments of the French Renaissance, harmoniously cohabiting different traditions and styles. It is a romantic vision of architecture - in rebellion against the academicism of the time -, a tribute to art as a whole whose perenniality is explained by its very diversity. Archives, models: a fasci.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: C’est dans le centre de Buenos Aires qu’Eduardo Stupia a décidé d’installer son atelier entièrement dédié à la création. Dans une maison du XXe siècle, coincé entre deux immeubles modernes, il occupe un large espace dans lequel il peut se livrer à son art de prédilection, le dessin. Ses œuvres, qu’il décrit lui-même comme des paysages abstraits, sont tracées au crayon, au fusain, ou à l’encre de Chine. Dans ses compositions hétéroclites, où le langage graphique et la précision du geste tiennent une place centrale, Eduardo Stupia explore la sémantique du dessin et ouvre le champ de l’imagination.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Le rockeur progressif Rick Wakeman et son grand ami Ian Lavender, célèbre pour son rôle de Pike dans Dad’s Army, s’offrent une joyeuse virée sur les routes secondaires du Norfolk. Accompagnés des experts Raj Bisram et David Harper, ces deux chasseurs d’antiquités sillonnent le comté à la recherche de trésors à vendre aux enchères à Nottingham.Rick découvre d’anciens graffitis médiévaux cachés dans la cathédrale de Norwich, tandis qu’Ian fait un détour vers le nord du Norfolk pour admirer la plus grande collection de soldats miniatures au monde.Mais un sage vieil homme japonais aidera-t-il Ian à triompher aux enchères ?

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Edgar Degas.You will discover his labour with Portrait of hilaire rené Degas, race horses, ballet rehearsal on the set.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherland painter, Vincent van Gogh.You will discover his labour with Self-portrait, Memory of the garden at Etten, Van Gogh’s chair.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Discover or re-discover the masterpieces of the greatest painters of history through our documentary series Within The Frame. From impressionists to surrealists, from Leonard Da Vinci to Paul Cézanne, every episode will immerge you into a virtual tour of a paintings collection. You will see the most impressive paintings ever made and won't miss a single detail.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Michelangelo Merisi (1571-1610), born in Caravaggio, is known as a wicked artist who had to flee Rome in 1606 after killing a man. But Caravaggio is above all a painter who changed the face of painting at the very beginning of the 17th century. Notice his use of colour in the people emerging from a dark background, like his “Bacchus” or “David”. One of his masterpieces is the cycle of the “Calling of Saint Matthew” in the chapel of the church of St- Louis-of-the-French in Rome.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Construction of the cathedral began in 1247 and was only finished in 1880 after an interruption that lasted more than 300 years. Ribbed vaults and flying buttresses, the film explores the architectural vocabulary of the gothic style and its building methods. It reveals the most recent contribution of metal to architecture. It demonstrates how this cathedral that embodies German unity is at the same time archetypal of the Gothic style and of a 19th century building.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Phil Grabsky, réalisateur récompensé à plusieurs reprises, pose un regard neuf sur celui qui est sans conteste l’artiste le plus aimé au monde en utilisant les mots du peintre lui-même. Moi, Claude Monet révèle de nouvelles facettes de l’homme qui a donné naissance au mouvement impressionniste grâce à un tableau et qui fut certainement l’un des peintres les plus influents et renommés du XIXe et du début du XXe siècle. Tourné à travers l’Europe, sur les lieux où il a peint, Moi, Claude Monet est une exploration filmique inédite et intime de certains des décors cultes les plus appréciés de l’art occidental.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Découvrez l’œuvre de Matisse à travers les expositions de la Tate Modern à Londres et du MoMA de New York (2014) et profitez de la performance originale de la danseuse étoile du Royal Ballet Zenaida Yanowsky, qui interprète les couleurs et le dynamisme de la peinture de Matisse sur la musique jazz de Courtney Pine. Ponctué d’entrevues avec des experts ainsi que d’images d’archives rares de Matisse au travail, ce documentaire permettra d’apprécier tout particulièrement le dernier chapitre de la carrière du peintre et notamment ses gouaches découpées.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: François Boucher (1703-1770) is the archetypal French Rococo painter. He paints mythological themes tinged with gallantry, for example in the beautiful “Diane resting after her Bath” at the Louvre Museum. His patron was Madame de Pompadour, whose portrait he painted many times. Influenced by the Enlightenment movement, he devoted himself to Chinese themes (“The Chinese Garden”), to pastoral landscape (“Charms of Country Life”) and to a certain sensual Orientalism (“Brown Odalisque”).Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Léonard De Vinci est le peintre Italien de la renaissance le plus célèbre. Il possède un talent inégalable (peintre, sculpteur, architecte, ingénieur, urbaniste, mathématicien, botaniste, philosophe, inventeur,…) Il a considérablement influencé l’histoire de l’art. Son usage de la technique Sfumato et du clair-obscur son encore étudié aujourd’hui. La « Mona Lisa » et « La Cène » exposé au Louvre et dans l'église Santa Maria delle Grazie qui apparaissent dans cet épisode font partie de ses peintures les plus renommé, admiré et parodié à travers le monde.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Les chefs télévisés Aldo Zilli et Ching He-Huang s’affrontent lors de ce Road Trip à travers le sud-est de l’Angleterre, accompagnés des experts Natasha Raskin et Paul Laidlaw.Aldo mise sur une bague en or malgré les conseils des experts, tandis que Ching espère que des antiquités d’origine orientale feront un beau score aux enchères dans le nord de Londres.En chemin, Aldo fait une halte pour rencontrer Jill, une doyenne de 200 ans qui fournissait autrefois la population en farine. De son côté, l’amoureuse des animaux Ching découvre l’histoire d’un homme qui, au XIXe siècle, a risqué le ridicule et la ruine pour protéger le bétail.

programme.title: Leonardo: The Mystery of the Lost Portrait
programme.desc: In 2008, the chance discovery in the South of Italy of an ancient portrait with strangely familiar features takes the art world by storm. Could this be an unknown self-portrait by Leonardo da Vinci? Controversy erupts among the experts. The implications of such a discovery have far-reaching consequences for our understanding of the work of this great Renaissance master.

programme.title: Manet - Degas, a troubled friendship
programme.desc: In 1917 the art world is ablaze: the famous painter and sculptor Edgar Degas has just died, leaving behind him a collection rich of dozens of works from Edouard Manet.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.desc: Private tour takes you on a tour of the "Picasso Masterpieces" exhibition at the National Picasso Museum in Paris. This exhibition tells the story of how Picasso's works became important collector's items for everyone. Picasso himself questioned the notion of "masterpieces". He concluded that there is not only one way to make a work a true masterpiece. During this private tour you will be able to discover or rediscover some of his works such as "The young ladies of Avignon" or "Women at their toilet".

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Cette exposition très attendue à la Royal Academy of Arts était la toute première rétrospective consacrée au portrait d'Édouard Manet. Couvrant l'ensemble de la carrière de cet artiste énigmatique et parfois controversé, l'exposition a rassemblé des œuvres provenant d'Europe, d'Asie et des États-Unis. Le portrait de Manet n'a jamais fait l'objet d'une exposition, bien qu'il représente environ la moitié de sa production artistique. Il a peint sa famille, ses amis et les personnalités littéraires, politiques et artistiques de l'époque, donnant vie non seulement à ses sujets mais aussi à la société parisienne.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: L'icône de la pop et actrice Claire Grogan retrouve son compatriote de Glasgow, l’acteur Alex Norton de Taggart, pour une quête de trésors antiques lucratifs. Anita Manning et Paul Laidlaw sont là pour leur prodiguer leurs conseils d’experts.Anita et Alex se retrouvent embarqués dans un Boat Trip d'antiquités, évoquant leurs souvenirs d'enfance sur le Clyde. Pendant ce temps, Claire et Paul découvrent de près à quoi ressemblait le château de Stirling au XVIe siècle.Le résultat de la vente aux enchères à Ayr dépendra d’une dame nue.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.sub-title: The City of Architecture and Heritage
programme.desc: The City of Architecture and Heritage is a place dedicated to the art of building, its challenges, its eras, its styles, and its great masters. How are the major buildings of our time and of the past designed? Why and for whom were they built? The museum brings together a collection that allows you to navigate through centuries of architecture, to admire masterpieces usually out of sight, and to understand the great evolutions over the ages, from the 12th century to the present day.

programme.title: Museum Tour
programme.sub-title: Le Message Biblique - Dans l’œil de Marc Chagall
programme.desc: Museum Tour is a series that invites the viewer to discover unique which, for the artists chosen, have been incubators of creativity and a source of inspiration. Under their patronage, some of those sites have been turned into museums or foundations where their memory and work have picked up a life of their own.Each of the episodes will tell the story uniting the artist with a particular place, seeking intimacy in the process.This show’s agenda is decidedly visual. Works of art and the places in which they’re set will be filmed in such a way as to arouse strong emotions, thus placing the viewer in the spot, as if they were present in the flesh. This angle for the spectacular and search for beauty will enhance the accessibility of the series for an uninformed audience.A family-friendly documentary series which, beyond the fascinating information provided, offers a sight, sound and emotional journey into a captivating, palpable and contemporary form.

programme.title: The Villa Cavrois
programme.desc: Manifesto architecture, the Villa Cavrois is the emblematic work of the architect Robert Mallet-Stevens, a figure of modernism.

programme.title: Firminy by Le Corbusier
programme.desc: The Firminy site represents one of the strong ideas of Le Corbusier, the merger and coexistence between three human activities: cultural life and leisure, sports, and worship.

programme.title: Women Painters, four centuries of struggle
programme.desc: Do the names of Rosa Bonheur or Artemisia Gentileschi ring any bell to you? Despite their skills, female painters were for long time ignored by art historians and remain unknown to the public. This documentary recalls the destinies and masterpieces of those women, between the 16th and the 20th century. Who are they? And what did they bring to the art field?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Goya: Visions of Flesh and Blood
programme.desc: Francisco Goya, considéré comme le fondateur de l’art moderne, est l’artiste espagnol le plus acclamé. En plus d’observer avec talent la vie et le passé mouvementé de l’Espagne, c’est un portraitiste doué et un commentateur social par excellence. Avec Goya, l’art du portrait atteint de nouveaux sommets. Cette exposition majeure de la National Gallery de Londres remet son génie en lumière. À travers une formidable collection d’oeuvres uniques et de lettres de Goya, nous analysons l’homme lui-même et le monde qu’il peignait.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Située sur la place Trafalgar Square à Londres, la Galerie Nationale est la maison d’une des plus grandes collections d’art Européennes. Celle-ci contient plus de 2000 peintures, allant du Moyen âge jusqu’au début des années 2000.Vous pourrez admirer des méthodes d’art et des œuvres d’artistes uniques au monde, comme la remarquable peinture flamande (Van Eyck, Vermeer), l’impressionnisme français (Monet, Cézanne) et surtout les maîtres anglais de l’art comme Hogart et Turner.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Housing a huge collection of European paintings from the Renaissance at the end of the 18th century, the Alte Pinakothek in Munich brims over with masterpieces. In particular it boasts several paintings by the great Flemish artist, Rubens, such as “The Battle of the Amazons”. Notice as well Durer’s “Paumgartner Altarpiece”, the impressive “Battle of Alexander at Issus” by the painter Altdofer, and also the “Land of Cockaigne” by Pieter Bruegel the Elder. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The Johnson Wax Administrative Buildings stand as a masterpiece of Frank Lloyd Wright, one of the greatest architects of the 20th century. At first glance, the building surprises: no windows but Pyrex facades, long brick walls, curves. Everywhere it hides, you don't know where to enter. Seen from above, it has this streamlined profile like the fuselage of an airplane or the hull of a boat. Seen from below, it hides and protects. Closed to the solicitations of the outside world, it is the world - a place that encourages concentration and work. A self-sufficient space. And yet, there is nothing oppressive in this place that promotes concentration. It is a sensual place, with warm colors - the famous Cherokee red invented by Frank Lloyd Wright - and rounded volumes. The architect had promised Johnson a building where everyone could feel like they were in a pine forest. He imagined a forest of tree-shaped columns: a metal base, a very thin cylindrical column that rises, widening to end in.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous nous rendons dans la banlieue Sud de Paris. C’est dans un quartier tranquille que l’artiste Elias Crespin se rend chaque matin pour rejoindre son studio. L’artiste d’origine vénézuélienne, y a établi ses quartiers depuis près de 5 ans et y façonnent ses créations un peu particulières. Ses sculptures sont composées de figures géométriques simples, des lignes, triangles, carrés ou cercles, qui flottent dans l’espace suspendus à des fils presque invisibles.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Russian painter, Vassily Kandinsky. You will discover his labour with Old city n°2, Park of Saint-cloud, Rider (improvisation n°12).

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Jean-Honoré Fragonard.You will discover his labour with Psyche showing her sisters her gifts from cupid, The storm, Night scene or the Beggar’s dream.

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Expand and Empower: Open Your Chest, Shoulders and Hips
programme.desc: Alignment isn't merely a physical expression. What we express is not always a window to what dwells within. Enjoy this strengthening sequence while taking the opportunity provided by the Expand and Empower practice to observe your alignment.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" offers a Pilates session to gently strengthen the body. Guillaume and Sabrina encourage participants to refocus and release stress with smooth movements and deep stretches. They emphasize the importance of breathing, which is essential for supplying oxygen to the muscles. This relaxing and effective session is ideal for a moment of well-being at home.

programme.title: Pilates
programme.desc: Stay in shape with our pilates courses!

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Release and Restore: A Sequence for Your Spine
programme.desc: Release and Restore is a sequence that brings you full circle through a series of poses that create space for reflection. You will release tension in your spine while attuning to the changes even the smallest actions create. What change will you make today?

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, c'est la pétillante Vanessa qui va se retrousser les manches. Cette Parisienne de 48 ans est une artiste infatigable. Collages, détournements d'objets et surtout peintures, tout est prétexte à donner libre cours à son imagination débordante.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Leftovers often end up in the garbage can. But with a little thought, it's easy to recycle them. This ecological and economical gesture can even delight our taste buds. Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: A good breakfast is a healthy, balanced meal made up of 5 energy-giving elements: protein, fiber, carbohydrates, healthy fats and hydration. Luana Belmondo offers us a healthy breakfast that will satisfy both salty and sweet palates: oatmeal, avocado and salmon, buddha bowl with chia seeds and seasonal fruit, and vegan panacakes.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Pays d'Auge is the beating heart of Normandy. Honfleur with its picturesque port, the Basilica of Lisieux, a major pilgrimage site, and the Haras du Pin, the cradle of horse breeding, illustrate the diversity of this land of traditions, where craftsmanship and gastronomy reign supreme.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: Concarneau and its centuries-old ramparts, Locronan and its cobbled streets, Le Guilvinec and its bustling fleet of trawlers reveal a Brittany that is both historic and vibrant.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The JuraThe Franche-Comté with its lush green landscapes is also home to innumerable picturesque towns. We visit Baume-les-Messieurs, with its majestic 12th century Romanesque abbey church; Dole on the River Doubs, capital of the arrondissement of the same name; the Château de Joux, a magnificent military ensemble from the Middle Ages.Directed by: Magali Nguyen (season 1, France, 2014).

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous allons voyager au Mexique avec les fajitas ! Un plat typique de la cuisine tex-mex. On va préparer ensemble des tortillas (galettes de maïs). Et pour la suite, des fajitas avec du poulet, des poivrons et des épices.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana cooks with the interpreter of the flagship title of Frozen: Anaïs Delva. Together, they will prepare two 100% vegetarian recipes, a philosophy adopted by the singer. On the menu: grilled zucchini fettucini, white beans with pesto and a vegetarian burger. Proof that it's possible to enjoy vegetarian dishes without going hungry!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Devi is 13 and lives in India in an isolated village on the shores of the Sea of Bengal, a country where only boys represent a hope for their parents. Over an hour of walk separates her from her school, through rice fields, forests and muddy water.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Olivier is 9 and he has got two sisters, Marie and Véronique. He lives in Senou, Mali, near Bamako. Although the front is hundreds of miles away, the war has hardened their conditions of life. With two old bikes for three of them, every morning Oliver and his sisters are trying to reach their school through the muddy tracks.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Kritika is 11 and lives in the rugged mountains of the Himalayas in Nepal, along with her mother and her grandparents. Her father went to work in Dubai. Every morning, leading a group of schoolchildren from the village, she crosses steep paths, frail bridges and waterfalls to reach her school.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Obdulia González Fierro is 9 years old, she lives with her parents and brothers in the imposing and desolate Sierra Tarahumara. To get to the religious boarding school in which she receives a formal education, Obdulia and her friend Irma have to travel 6 hours. They walk for 3 hours and spend 3 more on a truck. Along the way they encounter dangers like poisonous snakes and unstable trails in mountains that are over 2,000 meters high.

programme.desc: Learn to stay open, no matter what happens, with the Root to Rise sequence. This practice provides an opportunity to explore your capacity for receiving energy, while building strength and confidence. When you maintain a connection to grounded energy, you can heighten your ability to stay present in every moment.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" focuses on a muscle strengthening and mobility session, carefully designed to relax and energize the body. Guillaume and Sabrina start with a full warm-up, emphasizing movements for the neck, shoulders, and chest to release tension. Each exercise aims to improve movement range and posture, fostering a connection between the brain and body to prevent injuries. Through progressive rotations and stretches, the session stimulates joint mobility, especially in the knees and ankles. This comprehensive and nurturing approach is ideal for reconnecting with oneself while gently strengthening the body.

programme.title: Namaste Yoga
programme.sub-title: Create Your Calm: A Grounding Flow for Hips and Hamstrings
programme.desc: Cultivate a sense of peace and stability with the Create Your Calm sequence. This restorative flow stays low to allow for a deeper connection to the earth and its grounding energy. Connect with your heart more completely and welcome a softer awareness with this gentle practice.

programme.title: Deco Masters
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, c'est à Samia de jouer. À 31 ans, cette prof de sciences troque régulièrement ses livres de classe contre des bouquins de déco. Pour elle, la décoration, c'est un peu comme une histoire d'amour. Avec son mari, Samia a d’ailleurs acheté une maison qu'elle est en train de rénover. C’est l'occasion pour elle de s'en donner à cœur joie et de tout repenser à son goût.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her Italian friend Alessandra Pierini are preparing a pasta party. They'll be cooking pesto and sharing their tips on how to get it right. They'll also be making pasta saporita, full of color and flavor!

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana Belmondo and her pastry chef friend Laurent Favre-Mot prepare desserts from our childhood. On the program: panettone in French toast, and torta della nonna with lemon cream and pine nuts, a typical Italian dessert!

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: In north-west Corsica, Balagne, nicknamed “the garden of the island”, combines heritage and breathtaking scenery. From Saint-Florent, , a charming Mediterranean port, to the mysterious citadel of Calvi, and through Pigna, a hilltop village with an artistic soul, each stop reveals an authentic Corsica. This journey through unspoilt nature is shared with islanders proud of their land and traditions.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Baie de Somme boasts an exceptional natural and historical heritage. From the emblematic medieval town of Saint-Valery-sur-Somme to the gardens of Valloires Abbey and the colorful villas of Mers-les-Bains, this episode reveals the richness of the Picardy coastline. Amid marshes, dunes and vast stretches of wilderness, the bay is also home to remarkable wildlife, best discovered alongside the enthusiasts who strive to preserve its beauty.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: Haut-RhinWelcome to Alsace, a land of tradition endowed with a heritage of incredible beauty! In the Haut-Rhin, we visit the mediaeval town of Riquewihr, whose wine is exported throughout the world, and Éguisheim, a veritable picture postcard village. Finally, we take a stroll through Colmar, the ''little Venice'' of Alsace.Directed by: Nicolas Coutand (season 1, France, 2014).

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui c'est sur la route des champignons que Julie nous embarque. Rien de mieux pour occuper ses week-ends qu’une balade en forêt à la recherche de champignons comestibles. Certaines espèces, comme le cèpe ou la girolle, se conservent très bien au congélateur ou, pour les plus patients, en bocaux. Nous aurons également l'occasion de rencontrer deux Chefs passionnés par les champignons, devenus des spécialistes du sujet : Franck Quinton et Régis Marcon. Mais pour l’instant on prend la route, à la découverte de plats typiquement français avec d’étonnants champignons de Paris en Touraine, des morilles dans le Jura, des cèpes en Gironde, des russules charbonnières en Normandie et des coulemelles en Auvergne !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, Luana Belmondo cuisine un poisson de la Méditerranée, le rouget. Au menu : filets de rouget avec de la purée d'avocat et des carottes au cumin, et mille-feuille de rouget avec des légumes printaniers.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Luana Belmondo welcomes Delphine Malachard, who is gluten intolerant. Together, they cook gluten-free recipes. On the menu: chocolate soufflé and vanilla and red fruit financiers.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: In our season premiere we tackle the riveting question: How is it that some people have been able to reach the pinnacle of our human performance? Guided by Dr. David Behm, an expert in sports physiology, we venture into the lab to uncover the fascinating intersection of science and athletic performance. Then we take this theoretical knowledge into the real world, visiting a high-performance training facility where professional NHL athletes are honing their skills. There, we join forces with Ben Prentiss, founder of Prentiss Hockey Performance, to not only witness these athletes in action but also to understand how the principles of peak performance can translate into our daily lives for enhanced strength and well-being. We hear from the athletes themselves including Stanley Cup Champions and All-Star players about their philosophy on what health means to them. This episode offers an insider's look into the world of elite training, demystifying the science and practices that enable ath.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: New Zealand - The Blue Mind Part I
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health?

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: New Zealand - The Blue Mind Part II
programme.desc: We're still in New Zealand, where we look at the scientific and emotional benefits of water, illustrated by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection with aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we discover how New Zealand's abundant waters are more than just a natural spectacle; they're a source of holistic health and well-being.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: India - The Search for Mindfulness Part I
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. We discover the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas and the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.sub-title: India - The Search for Mindfulness Part II
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Health Explored with Mike Wahl
programme.desc: Bhutan embraces happiness above all else for its citizens. This approach has made Bhutan a model for health around the world. Is happiness the key to better health?

programme.title: My Zen People
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Dyrlege Pol tilbyr lindring til en blind jack russel og hjelper en melkeku som sliter med en fødsel. Dr. Brenda feirer høytiden med en fallskjermhoppende nisse og alvene hans.

programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Samtidig konkurrerer Gnash mot Carl og Champ i en spisekonkurranse som kan avgjøre hvem som har fordelen neste år, når dvalen er slutt.

programme.title: Præriehundenes rike
programme.desc: Det er vinter i New Mexico. I Highlands forbereder Carl og ungene seg på å gå i hi, men en uvanlig allianse mellom noen farlige rovdyr har skapt en stor trussel for præriehundene.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: En ny klasse starter på Pandaskolen. De små pandaungene har tilbrakt hele livet på fødeavdelingen, men skal nå for første gang våge seg ut i en verden full av nye inntrykk, nye lyder og pandaferdigheter de må lære. Mini Ling Lang, den eldste av sommerungene, oppdager at mora hennes er en flink klatrer og prøver å følge i hennes fotspor. Su Jin Junior er egenrådig, og mora hans holder han i sjakk med en streng og direkte undervisningsstil. De små tvillingene er for unge til å begynne å klatre, men gir alt når snøen kommer. Snøvær betyr ikke at skolen er avlyst, det betyr at timene blir vanskeligere. Mens de minste ungene begynner på skolen, er Tian Tians unge oppe i fjellene og nærmer seg slutten av undervisningen…og kommer litt nærmere et liv i naturen.
